subject: Helix Labs onboarding readiness & CS orchestration
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Helix Labs onboarding readiness & CS orchestration

Neha — transferring ownership for Helix Labs (deal HLX-2026-137). Contract executed 2026-09-20; ARR $480k, 12-month term; target go-live 2026-11-01. Key context and asks below. Please confirm owner and I'll introduce to the customer for kickoff.

Quick summary:
- Product footprint: Hosted Redwood API -> Dedicated pool (reserved capacity), model pinning to rdl-v2-7b-q4; embedding usage estimated ~1.2M tokens/month.
- Security/privacy: Customer requires VPC peering + SAML SSO (Okta). SOC 2 evidence requested (I attached current report).
- Success metrics: 99th pctl inference latency <100ms for 256-token calls; 99.9% availability during business hours; cost target <$0.003/token (post-optimization).
- Timeline: Kickoff with customer week of 2026-09-29; implementation milestones: infra & SSO by 2026-10-14, sandbox validation by 2026-10-21, pilot go-live 2026-11-01.
- Stakeholders (Helix): Emma Silver (CTO, integrations), Jaime Ortiz (Platform Lead), procurement@helixlabs.ai. Internal champions: Jordan Blake (AE), Dev Patel (SE).

Immediate CS checklist (suggested):
1) Confirm CS lead for day-to-day (please confirm).
2) Internal kickoff: alignment call to review MA plan, handoff items, and required trial credentials.
3) Create implementation runbook: VPC details, SSO metadata, expected subnets, firewall rules, and data retention policy (90 days).
4) Share sandbox API key and sample dataset to Helix for validation.
5) Coordinate procurement for PO tracking and billing calendar.

Attachments: Helix_Onboarding_SOW_v0.9.docx, Mutual_Action_Plan_Helix_v1.2.pdf, Helix_env_requirements.xlsx

Notes for CS: the customer is sensitive to latency — they will run a pre-production load test with 100 concurrent users; please book a load test window. Also expect a short negotiation on quantization/quality tradeoffs; we recommended rdl-v2-7b-q4 to balance cost and quality.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0133
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helix Labs onboarding readiness & CS orchestration

Thanks Jordan — I can take point as CS lead. I accept ownership (assigned).

Next steps from my side:
- I'll schedule an internal alignment (30m) today to walk the MA plan and confirm resource owners (ops, security, and SE). Can everyone make 11:30 PT?
- Ask SE (Dev): please prepare a short runbook with VPC peering steps and the expected CIDR ranges; also include a checklist for the sandbox load test.
- I'll prepare a kickoff agenda for the external call and request SSO metadata and a contact for procurement to speed the PO.

Questions/clarifications:
- Do we have an existing customer IP allowlist template, or should I create one from scratch?
- Any blockers on providing a non-prod sandbox API key by 2026-09-29? If procurement needs statements of work signed first, note it here.

I'll send the internal invite for 11:30 PT; please add any pre-read items to the MA plan in Drive.

Neha Kapoor | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-26T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Helix Labs onboarding readiness & CS orchestration

Neha / team — allocating resources here. Proposed implementation timeline and owners:
- Week 1 (internal): Runbook & infra prep — Owner: Dev Patel (SE).
- Week 2: VPC peering + SSO metadata exchange — Owner: Infra Ops (Karthik Iyer) with Dev as backup.
- Week 3: Sandbox validation & load testing — Owner: Neha (CS).
- Week 4: Pilot go-live prep & monitoring — Owner: Neha with Platform Eng on-call.

I'll block 2 days of onboarding engineering capacity for the sandbox load window (10/18-10/19) and one escalation slot during the pilot. Please note that Dedicated capacity provisioning lead time is ~7 business days once we have the committed configuration — plan to finalize config by 2026-10-06.

Also adding a few implementation notes:
- We should pin model variants to avoid drift during pilot.
- Recommend enabling prefix caching for prompt-heavy workflows; will reduce token costs and improve 99th pctl latency.

Dev — can you attach the VPC checklist to the Drive MA plan after today’s meeting?

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Silver <emma.silver@helixlabs.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jaime Ortiz <jaime.ortiz@helixlabs.ai>, procurement@helixlabs.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Helix Labs — Kickoff confirmed (2026-09-30 10:00 PT)

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We confirm external kickoff on 2026-09-30 at 10:00 PT (calendar invite accepted). Attendees from Helix: Emma (CTO), Jaime (Platform Lead), Anika (SRE).

A couple of asks before the call:
- Can you provide sandbox API credentials and a short example request payload? We want to run an initial smoke test prior to the meeting.
- We'll share our SAML IdP metadata and procurement contact during the call. Procurement will require the SOW and MA Plan; Jaime forwarded procurement@helixlabs.ai to this thread.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Emma Silver
CTO, Helix Labs
